description: Finds a token by symbol or contract address on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon or Optimism and returns its address, decimals and whether it is on Cleave's token list, with a flag when it resembles a listed token. A symbol shared by several listed tokens returns up to ten candidates by address instead of picking one. An unlisted token is found only by its address and comes back flagged, without a name or symbol. It fits before cleave_plan_swap when the user names a token by symbol and the address is unknown.

query.description: A symbol or a contract address

name: cleave_find_token
title: Find a token's contract address
